rows.TEXT: Clan Council"We are at your disposal, your highness. As counselors to Demosthene we have come to know how the realm is run..."

Yataa'Halli"That is true, but I have also been a potent force behind the throne. And now, I am sovereign. I know that our numbers are few, and we haven't even the protection of Wotan - the runes have been lost with the loss of life in the Great Wars."

Loremaster 
"The runes are not only lost, but they are also weakened! We do not know why this is so... We must Find the rest of the ancestral runes! And then, commune with our God - he who we have forgotten since the great wars!

Yataa' Halli"I will finish what my Father has left undone! The Clan city called Greyhelm has not been heard from since the wars... Contact them once more so we may expand our realm! I wish to unite the runes so we can worship our God Wotan once more."

Yataa'Halli"And furthermore... We must stop this war with the Empire. It is based upon suspicions and distrust, not fact. I have sent a messenger to ask for peace with their Nation. I plan to be an ally of the Empire, unlike my Father..."

Engineer"Help at last! We have not been able to contact the King since the great wars... an avalanche blocked the valley. Men were lost trying to pass over the mountains to the capital. We toiled for years to clear the way, but you reached us first!"
Dwarf"What is happening here? I hear the sounds of... war!"

Engineer"Yes! You must help, our armies cannot hold out against the fiends much longer! We do not know who these men are... they attack with very powerful spells. Our armies are yours to command, for we have no one to lead us!"
Purge the enemies from the ruins north of Greyhelm.

Yataa'Halli"Clansmen, our Nation is united once more. It has been 10 long years since the Clan council has been attended by all the Great Clans. This marks the end of a chapter in our history, and the beginning of another, happier one!"
Loremaster"And furthermore, now that the Clans have all 12 runes, we must honor Wotan with a ceremony. We have neglected our duty to our God in the past years confusion..."
Yataa'Halli"We shall right this wrong! Let us celebrate!"

Alchemist 
"From whence does this evil wind blow?"

Loremaster 
"This is not merely a wind, boy! It is the magic of Clan spells! Who casts these?"
King's Guard"Why have you been attacked? Did you threaten them somehow?"

Engineer"We know not the reason for this siege... There was no opportunity for diplomacy. Three days ago at dawn, the first enemies came from the ruins to the North. They have not ceased their attacks since - they are determined to destroy us!"

Loremaster 
"Who draws this storm to us? Who controls the winds with the spells of the Clans?"
Dwarf"The warriors told us that we could find the Rune enshrined on a stone altar..."
King's Guard"This is Sevendusk, once a Clan city - now just a pile of rubble. It appears the warriors recently moved into this dwelling."

Loremaster"Look, Braggi's Battle Rune is still here. Judging by these parchments it seems our adversaries were trying to unravel the meanings of the runic lettering. Thankfully, they did not get beyond a few basic spells."
Alchemist"Well, we now have Braggi's Battle Rune! At Elevil also we encountered Human mages seeking runic wisdom. It is a blessing indeed that the Clans at last possess all the runes!"

King's Guard 
"Yataa'Halli will be overjoyed. She so fervently believed in the uniting of the Runes! Engineer, report to the capital and tell Yataa'Halli of the joyous news! We will follow - after helping the citizens of Greyhelm rebuild their city..."

King's Guard 
"But who are these men? Perhaps Morok was right about the Empire?"
Wizard"We are not yet done our work here. You must wait! You cannot evade spells this powerful, Dwarves!"
Dwarf"Hum! These scoundrels have pillaged the surrounding countryside for decades. It was about time they were stopped!"
Engineer"Caution Milordl! The bones of much larger prey than we litter these waters!"

Dwarf 
"Yes, but these waters are also rich in treasure! The cargo of many a great ship has been deposited here..."
King's Guard"What riches! These men have waylaid many a traveler..."
Loremaster"Ah! The mystic Skull Bracer of the  Dragons! I recognize the skull insignia on its side... Whomever wears it will gain its protection."

Dwarf"Bah! It is impossible to breathe in this dank place! Perfect for Greenskins... They haven't much in the way of property. Although this scroll... I wonder if it may be of any use? The writing on this scroll is evil-looking!"
I think my magical library can be of some help to you.
How may I help you stranger?

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, she is known for her intensity in battle and her courage in the face of overwhelming odds. She once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.
